title: Course content-spec front-matter
description: Contract for specs/content/<course-code>/content-spec.md front-matter (Spec 006 FR-002). `status: approved` is the gate check-pipeline-gate.mjs reads before allowing any unit under this course to be treated as publish-eligible (FR-016b).

course_code.description: Must match the parent folder name uppercased, same convention as unit-frontmatter.schema.json's course_code.

status.description: Set to 'approved' by the curriculum owner before any unit under this course may be drafted (FR-002) or merged (FR-016b).
